name: mvp re-engagement seam — an ACCEPTED project's follow-up reaches the loop instead of ideation, opens slice 2 in a NEW loop, and leaves slice 1's loop directory byte-identical (PHASE-56 W-1, R-17/R-18(i))
description: PHASE-56 W-1. A project whose mvp_loop is ACCEPTED (slice 1 accepted, graph advanced past RUN_TESTS) receives an owner follow-up asking for more work. Before this phase the turn fell through processMessage to ideationEngine.expandIdea and the loop never re-engaged. Asserts: the re-engagement branch is reached (ideation NOT triggered); ACCEPTED -> SCOPE_DERIVED is a declared mvp_loop transition; a NEW orchestration loop is created and project_state.loop_id re-points to it; slice_index goes 1 -> 2 and slices[] is append-only with slice 1's record preserved; the new graph is halted at ENV_REPORT awaiting the owner's real Gate-1 act (R-16 — it must NOT have crossed into TEST_DESIGN); and slice 1's ENTIRE loop directory is byte-identical before and after (R-18(i)).
